rows.area: Named types, component references and derivation
rows.implementedBound: Named simple/complex types, selected derivation chains and shared component references. Explicit global simple-type final sets constrain source-bound direct restriction/list/union/simple-content extension edges. Inline anonymous list/union restriction bases preserve original unnamed type objects, inherited item/member/facet identities and source QName scopes. Inline anonymous decimal and xs:string/normalizedString/token bases retain actual unnamed base objects and existing facet/normalization/pattern ancestry. Empty unions are valid types with no values; preceding rejection corrected separately. Inline anonymous integer-family and Boolean bases preserve original unnamed type objects, integer exact facets/numeric patterns and Boolean fixed-collapse/pattern ancestry. Inline anonymous xs:date bases retain original unnamed objects and existing exact date enumeration, partial-order bounds, timezone and lexical pattern ancestry. Inline anonymous xs:dateTime and xs:time bases preserve original unnamed objects, exact calendar carriers and existing enumeration/bound/fixed/timezone/whitespace/pattern ancestry. Inline anonymous xs:dateTimeStamp bases preserve original unnamed objects, inherited required timezone, exact calendar values and existing fixed/facet/pattern ancestry. Inline anonymous gYear/gYearMonth/gMonth/gMonthDay/gDay bases retain original unnamed objects and existing Gregorian value/facet/pattern ancestry. Inline anonymous duration/yearMonthDuration/dayTimeDuration bases retain original unnamed objects and existing exact month/second value, family grammar and facet/pattern ancestry. Inline anonymous hexBinary/base64Binary/QName bases retain original unnamed objects, facet namespace scopes and existing binary/QName value/facet/pattern ancestry. Inline anonymous anyURI/language/Name/NCName/NMTOKEN/ID/IDREF bases retain original unnamed objects, facet sources, normalization/lexical/scalar-length rules and validation-root identity checks. Inline anonymous float/double bases retain original unnamed objects and facet sources, IEEE mapping/special-value transport and existing value/lexical facet ancestry. Named integer restriction chains preserve original direct base objects and exact integer facet ancestry; numeric-pattern integer facets compile original source elements.
rows.remaining: Other unqualified simple-type combinations, finalDefault, complex-type final, broader complex derivation and recursive models.

rows.area: Choice, all, nested models and occurrence breadth
rows.implementedBound: Finite sequence/choice/all models, occurrence bounds, named sequence groups and sequence mixed content. Bounded empty all/sequence and optional empty choice with empty typed values. Direct text-only implicit/explicit anyType local members in all roots retain physical-order facts. Direct text-only anyType choice alternatives retain selected-branch occurrences and physical-order facts.
rows.remaining: General empty-model occurrences, nullable/repeated outer choices, nested all/choice, terminal attributes/descendants, complex references and broader recursion/derivation/assertion combinations.

rows.implementedBound: Bounded string-derived names/tokens, Boolean, exact decimal/integer, date/dateTime/time/dateTimeStamp, binary/QName, anyURI, float/double, durations and five Gregorian fragments. Bounded ID/IDREF/IDREFS document graph with actual selected-member types.
rows.remaining: ENTITY/NOTATION semantics, unrestricted placements/precision, excluded identity augmentation/DTD processing and general legacy operator integration.
